mapper.update: UPDATE tb_orders SET ORDER_STATUS = #{orderStatus}, PAYMENT_STATUS = #{paymentStatus}, CANCELLED_AT = CASE WHEN #{orderStatus} = 'CANCEL' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE CANCELLED_AT END, UPDUSR_NO = #{updusrNo}, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId}
UPDATE tb_orders SET BRANCH_DEPOSIT_STATUS = #{branchDepositStatus}, UPDUSR_NO = #{updusrNo}, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ORDER_NO = #{orderNo}

UPDATE tb_orders SET DELIVERY_COMPANY_CODE = #{deliveryCompanyCode}, TRACKING_NO = #{trackingNo}, ORDER_STATUS = #{orderStatus}, SHIPPED_AT = CASE WHEN #{orderStatus} = 'SHIPPING' AND SHIPPED_AT IS NULL THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE SHIPPED_AT END, UPDUSR_NO = #{updusrNo}, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ORDER_NO = #{orderNo}
mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(PAID_AT) = CURDATE() THEN TOTAL_PAY_AMOUNT ELSE 0 END), 0) AS todayTotalSales, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(PAID_AT) = CURDATE() THEN TOTAL_PAY_AMOUNT - SUPPLY_PRICE_SUM ELSE 0 END), 0) AS estimatedProfit, COUNT(CASE WHEN PAYMENT_STATUS = 'PAID' AND BRANCH_DEPOSIT_STATUS = 'WAITING' THEN 1 END) AS remittancePending, COUNT(CASE WHEN ORDER_STATUS = 'PAID' AND MONTH(PAID_AT) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(PAID_AT) = YEAR(CURDATE()) THEN 1 END) AS completedOrders FROM tb_orders WHERE BRANCH_ID = #{branchId} AND ORDER_STATUS NOT IN ('READY', 'CANCEL', 'FAILED')

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN ORDER_STATUS IN ('PAID', 'PREPARING') THEN 1 END) AS unprocessedOrders, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN BRANCH_DEPOSIT_STATUS = 'WAITING' THEN SUPPLY_PRICE_SUM ELSE 0 END), 0) AS branchPendingAmount, COUNT(CASE WHEN ORDER_STATUS = 'PAID' AND SHIPPED_AT IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS shipmentPending, COUNT(CASE WHEN ORDER_STATUS = 'SHIPPING' THEN 1 END) AS inTransit FROM tb_orders WHERE ORDER_STATUS NOT IN ('READY', 'CANCEL', 'FAILED')

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM op_user) AS totalUsers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_branches) AS totalBranches, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_orders WHERE ORDER_STATUS NOT IN ('READY', 'CANCEL', 'FAILED')) AS totalOrders, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(TOTAL_PAY_AMOUNT), 0) FROM tb_orders WHERE ORDER_STATUS NOT IN ('READY', 'CANCEL', 'FAILED')) AS totalRevenue FROM DUAL

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(O.ORDERED_AT, '%Y.%m.%d %H:%i') AS ORDERED_AT, O.ORDER_NO, O.TOTAL_PAY_AMOUNT, O.SUPPLY_PRICE_SUM, (O.TOTAL_PAY_AMOUNT - O.SUPPLY_PRICE_SUM) AS MY_PROFIT, O.BRANCH_DEPOSIT_STATUS, O.ORDER_STATUS FROM tb_orders O WHERE O.BRANCH_ID = #{branchId} AND O.ORDER_STATUS NOT IN ('READY', 'CANCEL', 'FAILED') ORDER BY O.ORDERED_AT DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT B.BRANCH_NAME, O.ORDER_NO, O.SUPPLY_PRICE_SUM, O.BRANCH_DEPOSIT_STATUS, O.DELIVERY_COMPANY_CODE, (SELECT CODE_NM FROM op_code WHERE GROUP_ID = 'R010660' AND CODE = O.DELIVERY_COMPANY_CODE) AS DELIVERY_COMPANY_NM, O.TRACKING_NO, O.ORDER_STATUS FROM tb_orders O JOIN tb_branches B ON O.BRANCH_ID = B.BRANCH_ID WHERE O.ORDER_STATUS NOT IN ('READY', 'CANCEL', 'FAILED') ORDER BY O.ORDERED_AT DESC LIMIT 5
